verdict.rationale: Consensus's first-party llms-full.txt states it is 'API and agent ready' and that 'a REST API and an MCP server expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app,' so an official MCP server is claimed for agent connections. The evidence is a single repeated line, with no setup guide, tool listing, or auth details. Missing for 10: MCP server setup/connection documentation, list of exposed tools, auth/pricing details for MCP access, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can connect.
